#### Counterfactual account and smoking cessation

Suppose a patient quit smoking
and did not develop lung cancer.
On the counterfactual account,
quitting prevented the cancer
only if the patient would have developed lung cancer
had they kept smoking.
We never observe that second scenario.
It is the counterfactual outcome of @def-counterfactual.

:::
